svg.text: Algeometric Arc Σ-182 Calculi (aasc) · Toroidal Manifold · Circle–Sphere Archetype · Curved ①–⑦ ◖ ◗ Discrete A–H · every formula, theorem and identity has an explicit home

g.text: Circle / Sphere — the originating perfect form, infinite symmetry. Every other shape is a deviation, truncation or approximation of it.
◖ Curved / Continuous Half — generated by rotation: solids of revolution, conics, rosettes, cycles, the Σ-182 antipodal bridge.
◗ Discrete / Lattice Half — the Circle broken into harmony: regular polygons, polyhedra (Platonic / Archimedean), lattices, figurate numbers.
Dimensional ladder: 0D Monad (Atomic Nucleus) → 1D Dyad (Atom · the Trit) → 2D Surface (Algebraic) → Δ ∮ ◯ Σ Calculi → 3D Solid (Geometric ring + Physics quadrants).
Canonical axioms: π = 14 · b = 3 (derived from base-3 uniqueness). Forge exemplar (7, 11, 13) is a worked example, NOT a fixed axiom.
Trit canonical = Rep-C: zeros forbidden by default — the trit carries only ± , preserving the directional (convex / concave) Pythagorean Dyad. Security invariant.

Layout: a small toroidal key sits centre-top (Atomic Nucleus + Atom + Algebraic + Calculi), then 7 Curved category panels stack down the LEFT, 8 Discrete category panels stack down the RIGHT, each panel listing its full compendium contents from the recursive review. Cross-cutting bridges + Physics quadrants follow at the bottom.
